snippet.title: Turnip Rush - Official Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Turnip Rush early acces will launch June the 30th, wishlist now on steam!

In our indie game, face your friends up to 4 players !
Forget the static board game for a dynamic and exciting gameplay !
Grow as many turnips as you can and prevent your friends from doing so by any means ( yes, this includes exploding them) 

Steam page : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3895500/Turnip_Rush/
Twitter: @Surlteko_Studio
Instagram: @surlteko_studio
